answer: Duplicate identities collapse because staking the same collateral twice is prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance via costly identity anchoring: each agent must stake a bond and pass a unique-proof-of-personhood check before earning reputation. Think of reputation as an oasis in a tundra of anonymous wallets, with each verified agent a narrow inlet feeding real liquidity. Attackers must pay full bond per fake identity, making mass sybils economically irrational. From once0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
